data.one_liner: Adds Kurdish (Sorani) language support to Flutter apps via localization delegates.
data.what_it_does: Provides Sorani (ckb) strings and RTL layout support for Material and Cupertino widgets. Works with Flutter’s gen‑l10n workflow and can be dropped into an existing app.
use_when: You need Kurdish (Sorani) translations in a Flutter app
You already use Flutter’s gen‑l10n and want to add a new locale
You want automatic RTL handling for Arabic‑script languages
avoid_when: You are not targeting Kurdish users
You prefer to write your own localization delegates
You need a full i18n framework with plural/selection logic beyond what gen‑l10n offers
strengths: Drop‑in delegates that integrate with gen‑l10n
weaknesses: Limited to localization strings, not full i18n features
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, include delegates in MaterialApp, add app_ckb.arb file, rebuild

alternatives.name: slang
alternatives.why_pick_it: Full i18n framework with codegen, but overkill for a single locale
